privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: Lineup is a planner that runs in your browser. Your images stay on your device and there are no accounts. This page lists everything that is stored, and where.

sections.heading: Who runs Lineup
paragraphs: Lineup is made by studiobimo and served from lineup.bimo.dev.

sections.heading: On your device
paragraphs: Your images and your plan are stored in this browser and never reach our servers. For each image, Lineup keeps a thumbnail, a JPEG copy up to 1440 px wide, its size, its main colours, the date you added it and its place on your board. It does not keep the file name.
Lineup also remembers your theme, your language, whether you have dismissed the introduction, and any handle and name you enter for the phone preview.
Nothing here is copied or backed up. You can delete images in the app, or clear this site's data in your browser to remove everything.

sections.heading: Your Zernio key
paragraphs: Scheduling is optional. It uses Zernio, a separate service, with your own API key. The key is sealed and kept in a cookie in this browser that scripts on the page cannot read. It lasts 30 days at most, and you can remove it at any time.
No server stores your key. For each request our server unseals it in memory, calls Zernio and forgets it.

sections.heading: What goes to Zernio
paragraphs: Nothing goes to Zernio until you schedule a post. When you do, your browser sends the JPEG copy of each image straight to Zernio. The caption and time you chose pass through our server on their way there, and are not kept.
Zernio then holds them and publishes them to Instagram. Zernio's own privacy policy and terms apply from that point, and Instagram's apply once a post is published.

sections.heading: On our servers
paragraphs: We keep none of your images, plans or keys. We have no database and no accounts.

Lineup is hosted on Cloudflare, which handles your IP address and the pages you request, as any web host does, to serve the app and protect it. Requests to our API are also kept in Cloudflare's logs for up to seven days, to help us fix faults. Those logs do not include your images or your key.
There are no analytics, no advertising and no third-party scripts. Fonts are served from our own address.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: We hold no account or profile for you, so there is nothing for us to look up, export or delete. What is on your device is yours to remove, and our logs expire on their own.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If any of this changes, we will update this page and the date on it.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.summary: By using Lineup you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use it.

sections.heading: Your content
paragraphs: Your images stay yours, and Lineup takes no rights to them. You are responsible for having the right to use what you add, and for what you publish.

sections.heading: Zernio and Instagram
paragraphs: Scheduling goes through Zernio with your own key, and posts are published on Instagram. Both are separate services with their own terms, which you agree to follow. We do not control whether a post is accepted, or published on time.
Lineup is not affiliated with or endorsed by Instagram or Meta.

sections.heading: Keep your originals
paragraphs: Lineup is a planner, not a backup. Your board is stored only in this browser, and can be lost if the browser's data is cleared or the device fails. Keep your original files.

sections.heading: Fair use
paragraphs: Do not try to break, overload or get around the security of Lineup, and do not use it to break the law or other people's rights.

sections.heading: No warranty
paragraphs: Lineup is provided as it is, without warranty of any kind. As far as the law allows, studiobimo is not liable for any loss from using it, including lost images and posts that are missed or wrong. Nothing here limits rights you have by law.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may change or stop Lineup, and may change these terms. If we change them, we will update this page and the date on it.
